note:
PRD.md §9 Step 14 leaves the exact synthetic-audio method to the implementer ('any reasonable synthetic method satisfies this step as long as fixtures are labeled and reproducible'). Each 'clip' .wav is real synthesized speech (Groq Orpheus, canopylabs/orpheus-v1-english, voice 'autumn', 16kHz PCM16LE mono, matching the Adapter's fixed session config), reading the fixture's own 'transcript' field aloud, padded with trailing silence to at least 6s. The automated test suite (tests/regression/adversarial.test.ts) still drives the pipeline via the 'transcript' string directly against a mocked AssemblyAI server, per TESTING.md 'CI determinism' — that stays deterministic and reproducible by design; the .wav files are additional real artifacts, not a source of automated assertions. UPDATED 2026-09-10 (see TASKS.md's 'Straight answer on the three adversarial-suite categories' addendum) — three categories were live-verified and resolved:
(1) background_noise.wav and interruption_barge_in.wav: real AssemblyAI drops the dash ('brk71q9'), which the order_id regex used to require, so the entity was mis-typed as coupon_code. FIXED: the regex is now dash-optional and space-tolerant (packages/schemas/src/extractors.ts), with a coupon_code-vs-order_id suppression to prevent double-classification. Verified live against both real clips: entity_type order_id, normalized_value BRK-71Q9, action_allowed with the real order, 3/3.
(2) o_zero_confusion.wav and b_v_confusion.wav: real AssemblyAI produces a garbled transcript ('checking on order nv dash', 'status of order zxa-4 v8') that matches no entity pattern at all — previously nothing happened (no entity, no gate call, no repair; this had been informally assumed to be covered by 'generic' repair wiring that did not actually exist in the code). FIXED: a new no-entity-extracted repair path (services/backend/src/reliability/autoTrigger.ts's maybeStartNoEntityRepair, wired into realtime/gateway.ts) fires a repair question ('I didn't catch your order number — could you repeat it?') when a cue word plus a digit or the word 'dash' appears with zero extracted entities. Verified live against both real clips: repair_question fires correctly, 1/1 each (o_zero_confusion's second turn '150' alone doesn't resolve it, correctly retries once before it would escalate — that specific two-turn clip's script doesn't include a clear enough follow-up to fully resolve, which is a fixture-content limitation, not a repair-path bug).
(3) uncommon_name_spelling.wav and amount_ambiguity_18_80.wav: customer_name/refund_amount entities ARE extracted but reach no tool call since lookup_customer/request_refund aren't wired into autoTrigger's map. CONFIRMED FINE AS-IS: this is the documented Step 5 Support Agent placeholder scope boundary, not a gap the adversarial suite is meant to catch.
Only background_noise, interruption_barge_in, o_zero_confusion, and b_v_confusion have been streamed through a real AssemblyAI account among these 10; the other 6 (fast_speech, spelling_correction_mid_utterance, repeated_value, caller_changes_mind_mid_entity, uncommon_name_spelling, amount_ambiguity_18_80) have not.
